Amarnath Yatra 2026 to Begin on July 3, Weather Conditions to be Checked

The Amarnath Yatra 2026 is set to begin on July 3. The yatra will take place amidst heavy rainfall and snowfall in the region. The Indian government has advised pilgrims to carry essential items such as food, water, and first aid kits. The yatra's success depends on the weather conditions, which are expected to be challenging.
